Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js: returns n clamped to the range [min, max]
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js: formats byte counts with one decimal place using B, KB, MB, GB 
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js: converts to lowercase, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)

Each is exported from its module, and CHANGELOG.md has been updated under [Unreleased].
